listing.name: Dante's Inferno / hells-gate-recomp
listing.summary: Prepare a permitted Dante's Inferno PC player with your own Xbox 360 disc and keep its upstream launcher.

steps.title: Finish upstream setup in a permitted copy
steps.instruction: Use your existing permitted Windows copy with its own upstream instructions. The installed edition uses the upstream installer; the portable ZIP has no installer and includes DantesInfernoLauncher.exe, the native player and an original-disc importer. Choose DantesInfernoLauncher.exe with its folder as the working directory when registering it. Save launch details first, then choose Play separately.

steps.title: Import your own original through the launcher
steps.instruction: In the portable launcher, choose Play and deliberately accept its ISO import prompt, then select your own supported Xbox 360 Dante’s Inferno ISO. The launcher runs its bundled extract-xiso into the selected game-data directory. Portcove never invokes that tool during discovery. Keep the ISO and game data recoverable. The package’s bundled title-update patch and imported originals share game; do not overwrite a new package’s patch by copying an old whole game folder without upstream guidance.

steps.title: Keep upstream updates and your data together
steps.instruction: The installed edition can offer and launch its own update installer. The portable launcher opens the upstream release page and asks for a manual portable update; it does not silently self-replace. Close the game, keep the old copy, and back up userdata, dantes_inferno.toml, dlc and your imported original data before following the matching upstream route. With portable.txt present, normal saves/cache use userdata. Without portable mode, including normal installed copies, the default live profile is Documents/dantes_inferno; if Documents is blocked, the player can fall back to the dantes_inferno folder under LocalAppData. Back up the actual live profile, plus any custom game-data/profile locations. Portcove leaves the external files untouched and supplies no managed Update, Backup or Rollback.

warnings: Portcove downloads are paused while the selected package’s bundled game/default.xexp title-update patch has no established separate acquisition permission. Keep an existing permitted copy. Reconsider when upstream establishes the patch’s compatible distribution basis or supplies a package that imports it from your own game.
